description: Which crypto addresses did OFAC add to or remove from the SDN list? Per-publication change records (added, removed, entry updated), computed by Distill from OFAC’s own SDN files. Change records between consecutive SDN publications, diffed by Distill from OFAC’s SDN.XML: a digital currency address added to or removed from an entry, and an entry with an address whose name or programs changed. Each record cites the sha256 of both publications’ files. Pages of up to 100, oldest first; pass next_cursor back as cursor. The history starts at history_from. Updated daily. Price: $0.02 per call. Free tier: 3 free calls a day per IP, at most 3 rows per answer, taken by an unpaid call unless its _meta["distill/free-tier"] is "skip". Confidence: Freshness only (the list is OFAC’s, matched exactly): 1 until 3 days after the last check of OFAC’s Sanctions List Service, then halving every 3 days. Facts from the OFAC SDN list as published on the date stated: an exact match of the address as given (EVM and Bech32 addresses case-insensitively). Not legal advice and not a compliance determination: no ownership (50% rule) analysis, no indirect exposure, no other sanctions list. Computed by Distill from OFAC’s SDN.XML. See /terms.

publication.description: Only the changes of the SDN publication of this date, e.g. 2026-10-15.

since.description: Only records detected after this time (ISO 8601).
